name: hbm_su_static_bank6_clock7_1015-r11-COMMIT
purpose: Source-identical r10c bank after actual nativeL181.5/C121.4/spread24.4 PASS diagnostic, TT151.26/FF7.16 butDRC2 on one read-data net overmacro. Reserve all M5 over each 94.824um-wide macro (60um inwardguard > halfwidth), forcing transit around six SRAM bodies in existing22um channels; no new logic/latency/ABI or timing waiver. This removes overmacro/drop-via topology rather than tuning edgeguarddepth. TrialGRT/cuts, native audit and actualDRC0 required.
